lines.rom: jaya jaya jaharavira hare jaya jaya guga vira hare dharati para a karake bhaktom ke dukha dura kare
jo koi bhakti kare prema se ham ji kare prema se bhage dukha pare vighana hare mamgala ke data tana ka kasta hare
jevara rava ke putra kahaye rani bachala mata bagara janma liya vira ne jaya jayakara kare
mari mem tuma kari tapasya acaraja sabhi kare carom disa mem bhakta a rahe asa lie utare
satya ahimsa ka vrata dhara jhutha se apa dare vacana bhamga ko bura samajhakara ghara se apa nikare
bhavana padharo atala ksatra kaha bhaktom ki seva kare prema se seva kare jo koi dhana ke bhandara bhare
tana mana dhana arpana karake bhakti prapta kare bhadom krsna naumi ke dina pujana bhakti kare
